FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
A newcomer with no residency trigger yet may drive as a visitor on a home license, while 30 continuous days in Iowa makes that same newcomer a resident [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint residency-status; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F05 and sec01-F11.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
The 30-day clock is only one of the residency triggers, so voting, schooling, a job, a tax exemption, or state aid can make you a resident on day one [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint residency-status; prereq_hint sec01-F08; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F02 through sec01-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
Military members are exempt only while driving military vehicles on duty; the same person driving a personal car needs an Iowa credential [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint exemptions; prereq_hint sec01-F01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F01 and sec01-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
Farm equipment is exempt only between the home farm and nearby land within two miles; other farm driving on public roads needs a license [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint exemptions; prereq_hint sec01-F01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F01 and sec01-F10.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
The homestead and military tax exemptions are alternative triggers, so claiming either one alone is enough for residency [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint residency-status; prereq_hint sec01-F06; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with the residency trigger list.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A02
The knowledge test can never be waived, while the driving test drops away once the driver education course requirement is met [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint application-tests; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F16 and sec01-F18.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A02
The vision screening is a check completed at application time, while the knowledge test is an exam that must be passed [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint application-tests; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F15 and sec01-F16.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
Your license proves you may drive, while the registration and insurance card prove the vehicle is legal and covered; all three must ride along [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint carry-documents; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec01-F12 and sec01-F13.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
The online practice test only prepares you, while Skip the Trip is a real way to sit the knowledge test at home or school [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint test-channels; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F19 and sec01-F21.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
Driver education is a course drivers under 18 must finish, while the Graduated Driver's License Program is the separate under-18 program named on the same page [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint under-eighteen-track; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec01-F17 and sec01-F20.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0005]
